assumptions: Single serial collector producer and single consumer
collect_frames publishes a normal frame after poll returns and before pause starts
Original main loop drains FIFO before each dispatch check
Earliest drain bound is previous iteration completion, not an invented exact drain timestamp
interpretation: At most one new normal frame with zero motor events could arrive after the conservative drain checkpoint. This weakens the old motor-backlog hypothesis; it does not measure actual queue depth or rule out delays inside a single call.
